scope: Public current Slovenská pošta PSČ search, its page JavaScript and two non-personal sample responses, the current official access-point XML, and public Register adries portal, catalogue, eight NUTS3 metadata records and the exact current SK010 GeoJSON were audited without provider contact, registration, authentication, terms or contract acceptance, payment, protected person/property query, publication destination or deployment.

countryIdentity.rule: Repository and operator identity remain SK. Register adries NUTS3 codes and address hierarchy are source classifications and do not merge SK with another country or turn administrative regions into PSČ areas.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete Slovenská pošta five-digit PSČ assignment and exception denominator is pinned under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Every drawable code is reconciled to a valid fixed Polygon/MultiPolygon whose official/derived/virtual status, provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method, confidence and exceptions are recorded; point, route, P.O.-box, organization, office and otherwise non-area codes retain an explicit source-grounded reason. Register adries address Points and null geometry remain address membership only and are never buffered, hulled, tessellated or replaced by administration, cadastre, buildings, offices or synthetic geometry. The approved immutable artifact drives the real SK API/app, which normalizes five text digits and NNN NN display, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

officialObservations.finding: The official page offers PSČ search by street and municipality and shows no complete downloadable PSČ list. Its current page asset calls https://api.posta.sk/private/web/addresses with scope zip and limit 5. An exact non-personal Americké námestie query returned 81107 and 81108; a direct 81108 query returned no row. Bounded query receipts do not establish a complete assignment/exception denominator.

The official developer page recommends daily refresh of static XML lists for post offices, PoštaPOINT and BalíkoBOX. The exact generated 2026-08-30T18:00:00 access-point XML has 2,449 service records and Point coordinates, but no Polygon/MultiPolygon; office/access-point rows are not a complete delivery assignment denominator or PSČ perimeter.

The Ministry of Interior Register adries advertises address points, WMS/WFS, OpenAPI and download services as open data for commercial and non-commercial reuse. It is the address-identity authority, not the postal-area authority.

Eight exact NUTS3 address metadata records cover SK010, SK021, SK022, SK023, SK031, SK032, SK041 and SK042. All are daily, modified on 2026-08-31, state no public-access limitations, and bind CC BY 4.0 for author work, special database rights and original database; personal-data occurrence type is 2.

A Range request was ignored and returned the complete exact 127,488,925-byte GeoJSON. It contains 160,897 address features: 158,803 Point and 2,094 null geometry, 108 distinct well-formed five-digit postalcode values, zero Polygon and zero MultiPolygon. These are current real address memberships, not postal areas.

HEAD requests to all eight regional GeoJSON URLs returned HTTP 405, while an ordinary SK010 GET succeeded. The 405 responses are method-availability observations only and were not treated as absence or a rights restriction.

rightsAssessment.note: This is a conservative engineering gate, not legal advice. Register adries CC BY 4.0 covers the exact address resources, not Slovenská pošta assignment rights and not an absent PSČ area product. Public operator query/XML availability was not widened into production permission.

browserReview.reason: No complete operator denominator, fixed PSČ Polygon/MultiPolygon, code reconciliation or approved artifact exists. Real Register adries Points, offices and synthetic fixtures were not staged as production postcode areas.

reportPresentation.reason: The gate table and Point/null geometry counts communicate the decisive zero-area gap more directly than a chart.

blockerSummary: Current public Slovenská pošta search proves bounded street-to-code samples but not a complete assignment/exception denominator or compatible AGID public-serving grant. Current daily CC BY 4.0 Register adries data supplies real address membership: the exact SK010 file has 158,803 Points, 2,094 null geometries and zero Polygon/MultiPolygon. Access-point XML supplies 2,449 service Points, not areas. No fixed PSČ area artifact, complete reconciliation, real SK loader/API/map path or browser proof can be promoted.
unblockConditions: Establish a current complete Slovenská pošta assignment and exception denominator plus explicit compatible processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission, or an equivalent expressly open complete operator-authorized source.

Acquire a fixed valid PSČ Polygon/MultiPolygon product with exact provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method and confidence. Register adries Points/null geometry alone never satisfy this gate.

Reconcile every denominator code to valid official/derived/virtual area geometry or an explicit source-grounded non-area reason. Use no Point buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, administration, parcel, building, office, access point or synthetic proxy.

Build only an approved immutable artifact, then pass real SK NNN NN normalization, loader, API validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, loading/no-match/multiple/failure/invalid states, clear and re-search verification.
